Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> National | Politics “My mission remains to put the people first in the development of Akuapem” – Sammi Awuku 24 November 2026 6:21pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
The Member of Parliament for Akuapem North, Sammi Awuku, Esq., has reiterated his commitment to ensure he drives the development of his constituency with a focus on the welfare of the people of the area.
He says this remains his focus, and he is committed to investing into the people of Akuapem North so that development of the area will be felt by all.
“Our mission remains to put the people first and ensure that development is not just seen but felt by everyone because development must reach every community in Akuapem North Constituency”, he stated.
This is after the legislator had presented cheques to some constituents to support their welfare.
“The day also saw cheques presentations to 45 constituents to support their businesses, education and healthcare needs, alongside scholarship support for deserving beneficiaries,” he wrote on his Facebook page.
Sammi Awuku also hosted students from Akropong Practice Basic School who went to invite the MP, regarded by many constituents as a best performing Legislator to homecoming celebration.
“Another productive and inspiring day in Akuapem North! I was delighted to welcome the Girls’ Prefect of Akropong Practice Basic School and her colleagues to my office at Mamfe.
“Beyond their invitation to their upcoming Homecoming celebration, we had an engaging conversation about their dreams and how I can support their aspirations. I was particularly excited to hear the Girls’ Prefect speak about her ambition of becoming a lawyer and someday, Ghana’s Minister for Education,” he wrote.
